chats: Write a Python function that merges two sorted lists into one sorted list, with a docstring and two tests.
Explain in two paragraphs how a refrigerator moves heat from inside to outside.
List ten practical tips for learning a new language as an adult, one sentence each.
system: You are an autonomous coding agent working in the user's repository. You can read files, search the code, edit files and run commands with the tools below. Work step by step: read the code you need before changing it, make small and correct edits, keep the existing style, and explain briefly what you did. Never invent file contents: read them. When the task is done, give a short summary of the changes and how to test them.

function.name: read_file
function.description: Read a file of the repository (UTF-8 text).

function.name: grep
function.description: Search the repository for a regular expression; returns matching lines.

function.name: edit_file
function.description: Replace an exact string in a file with a new one.

function.name: run
function.description: Run a shell command in the repository and return its output.

agent_instruction: I will show you files from a project one at a time. After each file, answer in one or two sentences what it is for. Do not call tools.
nonce_policy: uuid4.hex at start of each independent user prompt; one per agent system prefix and session
warmup_policy: none; two calibration requests saved separately and excluded from measured statistics
